title: Mountain Springs Camping Resort

services.name: A Family-Oriented Campground
services.desc: Each weekend at Mountain Springs feels a little different. Some lean into food and music, others focus on crafts and family games. A few are built around themes or traditions that returning campers look forward to all year. Here’s what’s on the calendar and how to plan for it. Christmas in July Kids meet Santa. Campsites decorate. Candy cane hunts happen across the property. S’mores are served. This weekend fills quickly. Bring lights and decorations if you want to join in the glow parade. Easter Weekend Egg hunts for kids up to age 16. Coloring contests. Egg dyeing. The jellybean drop is messy and popular. Show up early or miss your turn.
